verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shopify acting only as an MCP server provider: its Storefront, Cart, Checkout and Order MCP servers and the AI Toolkit let external AI assistants and coding tools connect to Shopify. Nothing shows Shopify itself acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers and use their tools. Server-side MCP evidence belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
